first_attempt: An initial tree-proof capture looked for a .tree.gz file in the published 2625 git-objects directory. Its objects there are raw .tree files; the attempt stopped at the missing root file before capturing any tree object. An empty trees directory was created.
correction: A separate trees-v2 directory captures gzip reconstructions of the exact raw objects after Git tree identity verification; decoded bytes and Git IDs, not compressed transport identity, are authoritative. No prior object or failed record was overwritten.
